objective: Geometric mean of candidate / fixed NCCL finite-batch completion throughput over7 originalconcurrencycases
reference_plan: One unchanged NCCL complete-wave reference;3 unchanged PCIeCCL complete-wave repeats estimate noise. Original30s coarsecalibration discarded beforefreeze due14–22%boundarydistortion; no candidate evaluated.
noise_rule: Let spread=max(score)/min(score)-1 over three unchanged PCIeCCL scores. Freeze retention margin=max(0.02,2*spread) before candidate1.
candidate_rule: Each distinct source configuration consumes one loop, including build/correctness failure. No hidden configurations or sweeps. Start from retained incumbent unless a logged control is needed.
retention_rule: Correctness/provenance must pass. Screen candidate_score/incumbent_median >=1+frozen margin. For promising candidates run four fresh complete-wave evaluations in I,C,C,I order; require both fresh candidate/paired incumbent score ratios >=1+margin for retention. Screening sample is not confirmation. Keep candidate and incumbent source/binary snapshots; repeats do not consume source-candidate loops. Report baseline spread as heuristic, not confidence interval.
scoring_failure: SCORE0 for failed correctness, invalid provenance, external GPU work or serving error; distinguish invalid environment run from algorithm failure in the report.
final_confirmation: Fresh original fine matrix against NCCL with model/workload settings unchanged, plus full GSM8K for retained implementation. Report relative to both NCCL and unchanged PCIeCCL, including negative or inconclusive findings.
quality: Original tensor tolerances and supplemental exact guard tests are blocking. Greedy token identity diagnostic. FinalGSM8K1319/5shots/temp0/seed42/max256/concurrency64 requires zero invalid responses; compare candidate to unchanged PCIeCCL and report NCCL separately. Any candidate correct-count decrease versus unchangedPCIeCCL triggers exactly2 additional interleaved evaluations per implementation. If candidate median of3 remains below baseline median of3, label performance quality-unconfirmed and do not claim quality-preserving win; otherwise report no observed accuracy reduction under this repeat protocol, not universal equivalence. Preserve every quality result.
team: Codex-native supervisor, evolving architect/engineer role, independent reviewer. Serialize all GPU work.
telemetry: Dollar/token telemetry unavailable; do not report zero cost. Record wallclock and completed source configurations.
